name: implement-merge
description: Plan-to-merge execution loop that implements the newest plan in bounded phases.

interface.shortDescription: Implement plans through merged PR phases.
interface.longDescription: Plan-to-merge execution loop. Clears stale context, finds the newest plan, creates an explicit goal, implements bounded phases, delivers each phase with pr-delivery, and rebuilds already-running local containers after completion.
defaultPrompt: Use $implement-merge to implement and merge the most recent plan.
Find the newest plan, implement it in bounded phases, deliver each phase with $pr-delivery, then rebuild already-running containers.
Execute the latest plan through merged PRs and verify the completed goal.
